V1.source: Moussaid et al. 2009; Huber et al. 2014
V1.location: Moussaid 2009 Fig. 1b and section 4(a); Huber 2014 Table 1
V1.setup_status: native asymptotic speed measured over 10-20 s; Moussaid target is fitted desired speed from acceleration, not this window; human population/marker protocol not reproduced

V2.location: Fig. 3, typically developing group, graphical reading

drop_window.approach: first 2 s of capture starting 4 m upstream

V2.setup_status: source phase split verified; individual acromion shoulder widths and Table 1 speed-drop statistic unverified; archived spatial estimator differs; rigid discs cannot rotate

V3.plane: channel centre; y=0.4 is local video coordinate
V3.setup_status: nominal supply/density matched; archived initial sites adapted for 0.40 m margin; individual human starts unavailable

V4.all_data_window: entire experiment; counting plane, clock origin and denominator unverified
V4.setup_status: original counting line/window not supplied; exit-plane finite-N and 20-80% diagnostics are explicitly not source estimators

V5.distance_origin: centre of mass to obstacle edge
V5.setup_status: original obstacle geometry and ellipse extraction not supplied; diagnostic closest lateral centre-to-edge distance only

V6.onset_definition: first absolute angular speed above subject/speed mean maximum from five no-interferer trials; own X displacement to PoMD after marker filtering
V6.setup_status: source onset definition verified; source uses nonreactive interferer, 0.5 Hz Gaussian/5th-order median filtering and no-interferer baseline bank; reactive diagnostic does not reproduce this protocol, onset unavailable

V7.source: Zhang et al. 2012; Feliciani and Nishinari 2016
V7.measure: mean absolute Pearson correlation(direction,lateral position), second half of run
V7.setup_status: engineering segregation measure only; no universal numeric target

V8.setup_status: centre vs edge unresolved; retain both, no target difference
